board.note: 22x15 hex grid. Ogre enters from south edge (row 14), CP at north (row 2). Terrain via cell_properties.

ogre.note: Ogre Mk III cybertank. Subsystems tracked separately: main battery, secondary batteries, missiles, AP guns, treads.

movement.description: Units move up to their movement allowance in hexes per turn. Ogre speed derived from remaining tread units.

combat.description: Attacker sums attack strength vs target defense. Resolve on CRT (combat results table). Multiple units may combine fire.

ogre_subsystems.description: Defender may target individual Ogre subsystems. Each has its own defense rating. Destroyed subsystems are permanently lost.

overrun.description: Ogre may ram adjacent units after movement. Infantry destroyed, vehicles disabled.

end_conditions.condition: ogre immobilized (0 treads) AND all weapons destroyed
end_conditions.name: ogre_neutralized

end_conditions.condition: ogre exits south map edge without destroying CP
end_conditions.name: ogre_retreats
